[[File:Reanimate Monkey icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Reanimate Monkey''' was a [[reanimation spell]] which required a Magic level of 7 and an [[ensouled monkey head]] to cast. This spell would summon a [[reanimated monkey]] with five [[Hitpoints]].

Upon killing the reanimated monkey players would gain 182 [[Prayer]] experience and 0.5% [[Arceuus]] [[favour]].

The spell could be cast anywhere across [[Gielinor]], but '''only if''' the ensouled head was obtained as a drop from the respective monster, and the player were to cast it within an 31x31 area where that head was dropped by a monster. This worked indefinitely, even if the ensouled head was picked up, so long as it was not put into the [[bank]], [[trade]] screen, [[Grand Exchange]], or [[price checker]]. 

If the player had put the head into the bank, trade screen, Grand Exchange, or price checker, the reanimation spell would only work within range of the [[Dark Altar]].
